title: Tech Note: Upgrading Subtables to 4D v11 SQL
author: Josh Fletcher, Technical Support Engineer; Jean-Yves Fock-Hoon, QA Manager

historical_commentary.text: This note addresses a one-time, version-specific migration problem: subtables (a legacy 4D data structure) were removed entirely in 4D v11 SQL, replaced by standard related tables with an automatically generated 'special relation' for backward compatibility, while multi-level subtables were not convertible at all and required manual data preservation before upgrading. This is a purely historical migration concern relevant only to databases still running pre-v11 4D structures with subtables, which are exceedingly rare today since subtables have been absent from 4D for well over a decade; the note is preserved for historical/archival interest but has no practical application in modern 4D development.
related_updates: Subtables have been absent from 4D since version 11 (2007) and have no equivalent in current 4D, where related tables (and now ORDA relations) are the standard mechanism
Any database still containing subtables would have needed to complete this migration many 4D versions ago
